title: Open immersions and open restriction for $f^!$
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$. All schemes and morphisms below are in the standing setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: schemes are separated and of finite type over $k$, and morphisms are $k$-morphisms. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, and a finite commutative ring $A$ killed by a power of $\ell$. Let $\Lambda\in\{A,\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell\}$ be admissible, with the condensed coefficient convention and localizing closures of [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Put $\mathcal T_T=\Loc(\Dctf(T,\Lambda))\subset D(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})$, where $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ and $\Dctf$ means bounded constructible of finite Tor amplitude [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Write $f^!$ for the compactification-independent Brown right adjoint on these categories [det-sf-existence-brown], and $j_!=D(j_!)$ for levelwise extension by zero [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek; sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek].

1. For a quasi-compact open immersion $j:U\to X$ with $X$ qcqs [def-weil-open-immersion; def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], the functor $j_!:\mathcal T_U\to\mathcal T_X$ is left adjoint to $j^*:\mathcal T_X\to\mathcal T_U$, and $j^!\simeq j^*$ canonically, compatibly with the adjunctions.
2. For $f:X\to Y$ separated of finite type, an open immersion $v:V\to Y$, $X_V=f^{-1}(V)$, $u:X_V\to X$ and $f_V:X_V\to V$, there is a canonical isomorphism $u^*f^!\simeq f_V^!v^*$ of functors $\mathcal T_Y\to\mathcal T_{X_V}$; for an open $j:U\to X$ there is a canonical isomorphism $j^*f^!\simeq(fj)^!$ of functors $\mathcal T_Y\to\mathcal T_U$.
3. A morphism in $\mathcal T_X$ is an isomorphism as soon as its restrictions to the members of an open covering $X=\bigcup_aU_a$ are. The preceding canonical comparisons compute the restrictions of $f^!$ on $X$ and $Y$: $j_a^*f^!\simeq(fj_a)^!$, and for $Y=\bigcup_bV_b$, $u_b^*f^!\simeq f_{V_b}^!v_b^*$.

proof.text: Use openPullback_generators to prove preservation of the whole localizing closure. For every replete triangulated sum-closed candidate P on U, its inverse image under the exact termwise j* is replete and triangulated. The existing derived pullback/direct-image adjunction makes j* a left adjoint, so it preserves every existing coproduct, including the indexing universe in the definition of the closure. Therefore this inverse image is localizing. It contains all generators by openPullback_generators, and the defining intersection gives hs.

Its homEquiv formula gives exactly the required ambient Hom bijection. Transport he along mateOpenTrivialLowerShriek to obtain ht.
